revision: V5_ATOMIC_PUBLICATION_20261017; original contract preserved with implementation baseline

cases.title: Concurrent receipt submission
cases.scope: Two producers enqueue valid receipts over the one authenticated GW/UC connection; UC serializes processing and commits one snapshot.

cases.title: Changed late report batch after seal
cases.scope: Actual GW rejects changed input for a sealed slot; previous UC publication is retained.

cases.title: Cancel while private source calculation continues
cases.scope: After an actual private UC result, cancel before atomic public commit. Expose no numerical result or invalid archive.

cases.title: Concurrent API retry and completed replay after restart
cases.scope: One idempotent submission, new API process, unchanged published receipt bytes.

cases.title: API crash before publication commit
cases.scope: Kill and restart after an actual private result; terminate owned orphan roles, retain submission identity, expose no uncommitted numeric output. Separate mother test exercises successful recovery after root commit.

cases.title: Corrupted committed private stage
cases.scope: Alter a signature or integer type in a real root-committed stage after process kill; recovery must reject the changed digest and expose no result.
